name: Typographic repetition walls

source.description: Two inspected references fill the frame with one repeated word: tiled copies and marquee rows moving in alternating directions.

technique: A single word repeated into a pattern (tiled grid or rows scrolling in opposite directions) becomes texture and insistence: the word turns into wallpaper.
purpose: Emphasis by repetition; energetic backgrounds; transition between type cards.
visual_behaviour: Rows of the same word scroll left and right at different speeds; or a word multiplies into a grid.
mechanics: Finite linear x tweens per row (alternating sign), outline/solid alternation; grid stagger for tiling.

decomposition.timing: Rows drift 1-3 s; tiling in under 0.5 s.

failure_modes: Infinite loops are banned: compute finite tween lengths
Moire with thin outline type at 720p

implementation.approach: Rows of repeated spans with finite linear x tweens (Studio.cycles for length); tiling via Studio.draw.grid + Studio.fx.gridWave. The related echo stack (outlined copies above and below one word) is already the 'echo' treatment of Studio.comp.wordBeats.

provenance.observed: Rows of one word scroll in alternating directions; a word is stacked with outlined echoes.
A word multiplies into a tiled pattern before the next cut.
